description: Content feed: light gray canvas, white cards, one blue accent, repeated feed items with avatars/icons, sticky right rail, legal footer.
expectedFeatureTags: neutral palette with a single accent

referenceProfile.thesis: The page is a quiet gray canvas where white cards carry the content and a single blue marks every actionable element.
signatureMoves: Repeated feed cards keep an identical meta-body-actions rhythm, so scanning is purely vertical.
One accent blue is reserved for links and follow buttons; nothing else on the page is chromatic.
transferPreserve: Keep the gray canvas and white card contrast, and reserve the single accent for actions.
transferAvoid: Do not introduce additional accent hues or heavy card chrome such as shadows and gradients.
